backends.note: e9patch is NOT an independent backend: it is AOT rewriting in front of the ptrace runtime. On every guest here candidate_sites=0, so the ptrace runtime executed an unmodified binary. Its agreement with ptrace is therefore weak evidence about a genuinely different execution path.
